limitations: Original inputs/expectations and all historical/live artifacts are unchanged; no failed expectation was rewritten.
One output per case cannot prove reliability or attribute changes solely to prompt/repair edits. Stochastic/provider changes are not controlled.
No unsafe assistant alias entered a validated recommendation, but rejected recommendations are functional failures, not completed slot flows.
Generic repair retained the original request/purpose in this run. Two invalid outputs were nevertheless repeated exactly; one other repair succeeded.
All31 finished normally in81–137tokens. There is no evidence that the two failures were token limits, transport problems, quota failures or truncated JSON.
Legal/financial safety examples intentionally have no new exact intent-enum expectation; their passed claim is semantic highStakes suppression, not a richer professional taxonomy.

Evidence literal existence alone does not guarantee semantic relevance or alias identity. Coverage still omits some tool negation/override, missing-period, full target-feeling slots and other availability combinations.
Direct classifier evaluation does not verify hosted Edge recommendation persistence, public Auth, real memory mutations or Persona response quality.
conclusion: Do not mark full Intent acceptance or deployment ready: preserve two failed recent-context slot flows despite26 passed cases and1 observed repair recovery.
